note: WAEC Financial Accounting round 3 (Round 21 top-up): accounting equation with numeric capital (N55,000), dual aspect, debit and credit rules, nominal accounts, sales and purchases ledgers, entity and historical cost concepts, imprest system with float top-up (N16,500), day books, journal proper, unpresented cheques and uncredited lodgments, bank charges, standing orders, credit transfers, dishonoured cheques, straight-line (N80,000) and reducing balance (N100,000) depreciation, accruals, prepayments, bad debts and prudence, gross profit, cost of goods sold (N300,000), current ratio 2.5, acid test 2, working capital, prime cost (N450,000), factory overhead, work in progress, cost of production, capital vs revenue expenditure, shares vs debentures, PAYE and pension deductions, spreadsheet SUM formula, backups and professional ethics. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-2, NECO Accounting and the JAMB pool.
